description:
Senior engineering analyst for code review, plan review, and automation review.
Use when: (1) "review this", "analyze the code", "check this plan",
(2) After implementation to verify quality, (3) "is this good enough?",
(4) Before marking a task complete, (5) Reviewing a blueprint from /architect,
(6) Reviewing output from /refinery. Four-lens review: architecture, code
quality, reliability, performance. Reads from system/blueprints/ and source
code. Outputs to system/reviews/.
